origins.arcanaorigins.emberborn.name: Emberborn
origins.arcanaorigins.emberborn.descript: Fire answers you. Hurl fireballs, set an ember sprite on your foes and wheel flame around you; fire and lava can't touch you, but water and rain burn.
power.arcanaorigins.emberborn_fireball.d: Hurl a fireball that bursts where it lands, burning everything around it. Melts frozen foes and vaporizes wet ones. 1.5-second cooldown.
power.arcanaorigins.emberborn_ember_spri: Set a little fire spirit where you look: for 8 seconds it spits fire bolts at your foes, then pops. 20-second cooldown.
power.arcanaorigins.emberborn_pyronado.d: Three wheels of flame circle you for 8 seconds, burning and shoving whatever they sweep. 60-second cooldown.
power.arcanaorigins.emberborn_fire_immun: Fire and lava can't hurt you.
power.arcanaorigins.emberborn_scorch.des: Your hits on burning foes are a quarter harder.
